_comment: Every number the engine uses lives here. Sources: docs/sources/01..05. Times are wall-clock in `sessions.timezone` (DST-aware via Intl). Tolerances expressed in ATR multiples scale across instruments.

history._note: 72 h of 1m history (5 Binance pages of 1000). The 1h bias needs emaBias+10 = 60 closed hours to warm, so anything under 3600 leaves the bias 'neutral' for hours after a start. maxCandlesPerTf must hold the whole backfill at 1m.

liquidity._note: sweepReclaimCandles: a sweep whose candle did not close back on the original side still counts as reclaimed if a close does within this many later candles (reported as reclaimedAfter).

orderflow._note: absorptionMeanCandles: the volume baseline is the mean of this many candles BEFORE the candidate, so a spike cannot inflate its own mean.

czt._note: triggerMaxAgeCandles: a CVD divergence or structure break older than this many analysis-TF candles no longer counts as a trigger. minStopAtr: a stop closer than this to entry is widened AWAY from entry (a few-tick stop under a shallow sweep is inside the spread; the R it promises is fiction). zone.prevCandle: the last closed htf (4h) candle's high/low — source 01's 'swept below the previous candle's low'.

risk._note: Mirrors the executor caps (1 %/trade, 5 %/day). balance is a display assumption for sizing — the executor reads the real one.

footprint._note: SPEC-PRO §P1/§P5. bucketAtr: footprint level size as an ATR multiple (snapped to the symbol tick). imbalanceRatio 3 = the 300 % diagonal rule (source 05 §3). backfillMaxRequests × 1000 trades is the most aggTrades history fetched at start (≈ the last 15–40 min for BTCUSDT) — footprints built from a truncated tape are flagged partial.

orderbook._note: SPEC-PRO §P2/§P5. Visible top of book only (depth20), never level 3. wallMult × median qty of a side's levels = a wall; a wall absent for pullWindowMs was pulled (spoof) unless ≥ absorbRatio × its size printed at its price; imbalanceMin is the |bid−ask|/(bid+ask) depth imbalance the condition.bookImbalance hit needs.

notify._note: SPEC-PRO §P3. Telegram alerts — enabled only when ANALYST_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and ANALYST_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID are set in the environment (never in a file). digestAt is wall-clock in sessions.timezone; the daily digest is remembered per London day in <journal.dir>/notify-state.json.

executorBridge._note: OFF by default. When enabled, grade-A XAUUSD setups are POSTed to the executor's TradingView webhook (shape: {secret, alert_id, side, entry, sl, tp}). The secret comes from the ANALYST_EXECUTOR_SECRET env var, never from a file in the vault. Every existing executor gate still applies.
